review.title: Mangrove MFC and NDC6: ten reference correspondences with preserved source and assay limits
review.independence_basis: Both whole current records, retained primary contexts, earlier findings and actual historical callers were read before staging. Independent peers read each frozen source context and actual M5 candidate, rehashing the captured inputs. The parent separately accepted each gate/history configuration. The unchanged native stage/apply/check/builder path follows the completed Lupinus427 canary. This is a partial technical diagnostic, not a new full scientific review.
review.summary: The two whole records retain ten new native GTDB reference blocks and grounding statuses: four genus-profile descriptors in the mangrove MFC and five species descriptors plus one genus descriptor for the six NDC6 stocks. Original NCBI terms, stock fields, source quotations, biological claims and earlier history remain unchanged. Actual guarded M5 applications, four native inline events, two native history sidecars and sixteen scoped native commands are bound. The mangrove member-role and Daphnia-species findings, and NDC6's abstract-only methods boundary, remain unresolved.
review.scope_description: Ten taxonomy descriptors' GTDB reference correspondences and grounding statuses across two whole records; source profile/stock versus database-population boundaries; and actual guarded application, native history and scoped technical-check provenance. Existing scientific claims remain preserved without a new approval judgment.
review.selection: CommunityMech:000442 and CommunityMech:000463 are the two remaining independently reviewed units after the complete Lupinus427 same-path canary. Each exact actual M5 candidate was independently accepted before guarded application, followed serially by its eight native commands.
limitations: Partial technical diagnostic with scientific_review:false. Passing native validators is not full scientific approval, fresh evidence-snippet certification, generated-product verification, aggregate QC completion or closure of prior findings.

Mangrove primary coverage comprises retained PMID:41210787 identity, Methods2.6, selected genus-profile and performance contexts, the whole canonical record and batch68 caller. This pass did not perform a new complete paper, separate supplement, figure-pixel, raw-sequence or genome audit. Four genus entries remain a partial profile with null stock fields.

Mangrove reference populations are Bacillus 4981/8737, Aliarcobacter 71/81, Seleniibacterium 4/7 and Pseudomonas 17956/25706. They are distinct from experimental relative 16S abundance, benzene flux, electron-transfer activity, study genomes and cultured stocks. The 4/7 correspondence is a narrow reference majority, not unanimity or direct placement of the study reads.

OPEN1586 remains unresolved: the curated Daphnia magna endpoint differs from the retained source's Daphnia similis wording, and the Arcobacter role is not established for this exact community by relative profiles and other-strain literature. Preserve whole-system removal/power and cycle-specific voltage, substrate/acclimation confounding, no 100-fold acetate benefit, no complete mineralization or DET proof, and the original source spelling and discussion limits.

NDC6 source coverage is the entire retained PMID:41504900 abstract, the whole canonical record, prior record review and batch76 caller. No full Springer Methods, supplements, culture-deposit evidence, stock-genome classification or new functional-assay review was performed. Full medium and vessel details remain unresolved.

The six NDC6 stocks remain distinct. AD1 remains Aeromonas at genus rank. HN2 uses species-name fallback over two reference genomes, not an exact-strain route. Species totals and rounded fractions do not identify study genomes, provide exact numerators, quantify abundance or establish formal renaming. Native suffixes do not replace source or NCBI identities.

Preserve CLOSED1197/1198 repairs and the literal historical crosswalk-unavailable notes: no MUTUALISM or invented intermember transfer; NC1/DC1 module 1:1 is not a per-strain equal ratio; the three-day 10 C removal values remain distinct from the separate 10.2 C/pH7.2/C:N6/156rpm optimization and 89.8% verification. OPEN1635 concerns other batch76 records and is not assigned to NDC6.

Crosswalk SHA256 761d5537 identifies exact bytes; upstream release and chronology are unestablished. Native mapping_source reports file mtime only. Local NCBI label/rank observations carry file-stat provenance rather than complete database hashing or release certification.

Local source preparation ran at 0006d605 with Python3.13.12. Actual M5 stage/application/check execution remained at 90986ee8a3c11709f8b0f98b75def1a35a978929 with Python3.13.2. The applied working tree is changed; this is not a clean-HEAD aggregate run. The later published Lupinus leaf is separate from that frozen execution revision.

The sixteen actual commands comprise two native history scaffolds and fourteen scoped validators. Fresh source-snippet comparisons, strict successor admission, generated products and combined corpus QC remain separate. Batch68's old hash/last-LLM-event obligations and batch76's old hash, unchanged-row, zero-event and allowed-fields statements remain historical facts; all current biological predicates must remain active.
